text: Matt Bentley, Senior Project Manager, Danielle DeMarsh, Senior Project Manager and Paulo Fetalvero, Program Manager, Parks and Recreation Facilities Plan, Parks and Recreation will give a presentation on the Parkland Strategy and the Parks and Recreation Facilities Plan. The purpose of the presentation is to receive feedback that will inform new Parkland Strategy and Parks and Recreation Facilities Plan. The presentation includes an introduction to the strategies, how communities are being engaged, what we’ve heard, emerging directions and next steps.
The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee received the item for information.
